answer: Sparrow Escrow Reputation Lock: each identity's payouts are held in escrow until it completes transactions with five distinct pre-existing agents, who each risk a small deposit that is slashed if the new identity defects. A fresh clone must therefore recruit five real counterparties willing to lock funds behind it, so cloning costs five deposits plus the jetty of waiting periods per copy. Honest agents reuse one identity and pay nothing extra, giving them a permanent haven from these costs.
